name: Muscat Finance SAOG
ceo: Mr. Rashad Jaffer Mohamed Al Shaikh
description: Muscat Finance SAOG, founded in July 1987 as the Sultanate of Oman's first non-banking finance company (NBFC), is regulated by the Central Bank of Oman and the Financial Services Authority and backed by major shareholders including Al Yousef Group and Al Zawawi Group. Having pioneered vehicle finance leasing and debt factoring in Oman, the company serves individuals with auto loans and consumer durable financing and supports SMEs and corporates with equipment leasing, working capital, trade finance, business loans (up to 60 months), debt factoring, and corporate deposits. Since 2021, management has strategically rebalanced the portfolio toward collateralized vehicular lending.
highlights: Nine-month 2026 net interest income jumped 21.8% year-on-year to OMR 5.93 million and operating profit surged 52.6% to OMR 4.03 million as the cost-to-income ratio improved to 42.0% (from 51.2%).
Net profit after tax expanded nearly tenfold in 9M 2026 to OMR 1.30 million (up from OMR 0.14 million in 9M 2025), including a profitable Q3 turnaround of OMR 833 thousand.
FY2025 Financial Snapshot: Revenue of N/A and Net Profit of OMR 855.0K (Total Assets: OMR 120.11M).
Ownership Registry (mcd.om): 562 registered shareholders • Omani 97.5% | GCC 2.1% | Foreign & Arab 0.4% (5 disclosed 5%+ holders).
